"Would hearing about that type of evidence affect your ability to serve as a fair and impartial juror in this case?" the questionnaire asked.

The next question asked: "There may be evidence in this case about abortions. Would hearing about that type of evidence affect your ability to serve as a fair and impartial juror in this case?"

The questionnaire continued, "Have you or has anyone close to you ever sought treatment (court-ordered or otherwise) for sex addiction or sexual deviance?"
